characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.role: One of GTA VI's two playable leads
characters.summary: An ex-Army drifter working for drug runners in the Leonida Keys who wants an easy life — and keeps not getting one.
characters.details: Rockstar's official bio: "Jason wants an easy life, but things just keep getting harder." He grew up around grifters and crooks, joined the Army to escape a troubled adolescence, got in trouble and did not leave on the best of terms. He ended up in the Keys working for local drug runners — staying rent-free in one of Brian Heder's properties in exchange for helping with local shakedowns (and stopping by for Lori's sangria). Rockstar frames meeting Lucia as the story's hinge: "Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him."

characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.role: GTA VI's second playable lead — the series' first playable female protagonist
characters.summary: Fresh out of the Leonida Penitentiary, Lucia wants better for herself and her family — and sees a life with Jason as her way out.
characters.details: Rockstar's profile says Lucia's fight for her family resulted in her imprisonment at the Leonida Penitentiary; the prologue is set there on the eve of her release. She has learned from the experience and intends to make smarter decisions. She hid her pregnancy from Jason; her son is named Tomas. Her mother is Mia Caminos, a Vice City real estate agent. On Jason: a life with him could be her way out, "but it's hard to tell if that's the way things will go."
characters.voice: Manni L. Perez (voice and motion capture)
characters.faq: Is Lucia trans in GTA 6? No — nothing in the game or marketing supports it. The rumor began with a sourceless viral tweet in December 2023. In-game evidence points the other way: all characters refer to Lucia as a woman, the prologue places her in a women's-only prison, and the story makes clear she hid her pregnancy from Jason. Rockstar has not commented.

characters.name: Mandy
characters.role: Brian Heder's tenant — the viral Chapter 1 character
characters.summary: A tenant of Brian Heder's in the Leonida Keys, met in "Pipework" when Jason collects her rent — flirtatious, memorable, and possibly hiding something dark.
characters.details: SPOILER-LEVEL DETAIL: In the mission Pipework (the game's third mission), Jason visits Mandy's house to collect overdue rent. She refuses to pay until he fixes her blocked kitchen sink — and spends the visit flirting with him; he rebuffs her. The scene went viral for its horror-movie hints: a severed finger in her sink, tubs of acid next to what appears to be a fresh grave in her garden. The game never explicitly confirms she is a serial killer. She was not in any trailer — most players met her on launch day.
characters.voice: Lexie Shoaibi (voice and motion capture; confirmed by the actress on Instagram after launch)

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.role: Old-school Keys smuggler — Jason's first boss and landlord
characters.details: A drug runner from "the golden age of smuggling" in the Keys. He lets Jason live rent-free in one of his properties as long as Jason helps with local shakedowns and stops by for Lori's sangria. Jason's early errands for Brian — including collecting Mandy's rent in Pipework — open the story.

characters.name: Lori Heder
characters.details: Brian's partner; known for her sangria, which Brian asks Jason to stop by for.

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.details: Rockstar's bio: "Cal feels safest hanging at home, snooping on Coast Guard comms with a few beers and some private browser tabs open... Cal is at the low tide of America and happy there. Casual paranoia loves company, but his friend Jason has bigger plans." A friend of Jason's and an associate of Brian's.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.role: Vice City businessman — Only Raw Records
characters.details: A local Vice City legend who transformed street money into a legitimate-looking empire: real estate, the Jack of Hearts strip club, and a recording studio. All smiles until it's time to talk business. His priority is Only Raw Records with young music mogul Dre'Quan — "now they just need a hit." Jason and Lucia are shown running a drug-collection job for him.

characters.name: Dre'Quan
characters.role: Aspiring music mogul — Boobie's partner at Only Raw Records
characters.details: Boobie Ike's partner in Only Raw Records. The duo need a hit record — and Jason and Lucia's story intersects with their label business.

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.details: Credited in Rockstar's official launch credits as Raul Bautista, played by Manny Perez (a different credited name from Lucia's actress Manni L. Perez). Jason and Lucia run a car-stealing job for him ("Car Service").

characters.name: Mia Caminos
characters.role: Lucia's mother — Vice City real estate agent
characters.details: Lucia's mother and Tomas's grandmother. By Chapter 3 she has just opened her own real estate business in Vice City; her first listing is a run-down house in Hamlet. Mother and daughter once lived together in Liberty City — the life Mia dreamed of there is what drives Lucia after prison. First appears in Mami Knows Best; both of her missions are played as Lucia.

characters.name: Niko Bellic (cameo)
characters.details: SPOILER: Niko Bellic, protagonist of GTA 4 (2008), appears as an older man in a cutscene in "Taking Liberties" (Chapter 5: Top of the World, Ma). He confronts shipping boss Giorgio Gallo over a $2 billion cartel shipment that went missing, mentions he hasn't killed anybody since 2012, knocks Gallo down, points a gun at him, looks at Jason, and leaves. Rockstar's credits list his actor only as "The Hitman" to avoid spoiling the cameo.

characters.name: Donnie
characters.details: A main-cast character connected to Jason's Keys circle (missions including "Don Gone" and "Clean Up After Donnie").

characters.name: Giorgio Gallo
characters.details: Runs a shipping business that moves cartel cargo through Vice City. A seized $2 billion cocaine shipment puts his cartel relationships in danger — bringing Niko Bellic into the dispute in Taking Liberties.
